summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion (Volaris) to report the results of its annual general ordinary shareholders meeting held on April 24, 2026. The filing attaches a press release and a summary of resolutions adopted, covering approval of financial statements, directors' performance, and standard agenda items. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. As a foreign private issuer's routine meeting notice, it maps to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07 but involves no actionable corporate transaction.
